nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) _balances in ERC20 storing the token balance of every account
Private nested mapping _allowances[owner][spender] in ERC20 storing approved spending amounts
Private uint256 _totalSupply in ERC20, total number of minted tokens
Private string _name of the ERC20 token
Private string _symbol of the ERC20 token
Private constant string _GENERATOR holding the generator URL
Private string _version of the generator, set in GeneratorCopyright constructor
ERC20 constructor setting _name and _symbol from the name_ and symbol_ arguments
Context._msgSender() internal view returning msg.sender
Context._msgData() internal view returning msg.data
name() public view returning the _name state variable
symbol() public view returning the _symbol state variable
decimals() public pure returning 18
totalSupply() public view returning _totalSupply
balanceOf(address account) public view returning _balances[account]
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public, calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view returning _allowances[owner][spender]
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public, calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public, moves tokens and decrements the caller allowance
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public, adds to the current allowance
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public, subtracts from the current allowance
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal, performs balance bookkeeping and emits Transfer
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal, increases _totalSupply and _balances[account]
_burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal, decreases balance and _totalSupply
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal, writes _allowances and emits Approval
_beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual hook called by transfer/mint/burn
ServicePayer constructor (address payable receiver, string serviceName) payable, performs an external payable call
GeneratorCopyright constructor(string version_) assigning _version
generator() public pure returning the constant _GENERATOR string
version() public view returning the _version state variable
SimpleERC20 constructor (name_, symbol_, initialBalance_, feeReceiver_) payable, checks supply and mints to _msgSender()
msg.sender, the caller address used for authorization and as the mint recipient
IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) external payable call to an arbitrary receiver address during construction
Arithmetic: _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer
Arithmetic: _balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer
Arithmetic: _totalSupply += amount inside _mint
Arithmetic: _totalSupply -= amount inside _burn
Arithmetic: currentAllowance - amount inside transferFrom before writing the new allowance
Arithmetic: currentAllowance - subtractedValue inside decreaseAllowance
name_ string parameter of SimpleERC20/ERC20 constructors, used to set _name
symbol_ string parameter of SimpleERC20/ERC20 constructors, used to set _symbol
initialBalance_ uint256 parameter, the amount minted to the deployer
feeReceiver_ address payable parameter forwarded to ServicePayer as the receiver
receiver address payable parameter of ServicePayer constructor, target of the external pay call
serviceName string parameter of ServicePayer constructor passed to the external pay call
version_ string parameter of GeneratorCopyright constructor assigned to _version
recipient address parameter received by transfer/_transfer for the destination account
amount uint256 parameter used by transfer, transferFrom, approve, _transfer, _mint and _burn
sender address parameter of transferFrom/_transfer, the source account
spender address parameter of approve/allowance/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance/_approve
owner address parameter of allowance/_approve, the allowance holder
addedValue uint256 parameter of increaseAllowance added to the current allowance
subtractedValue uint256 parameter of decreaseAllowance subtracted from the current allowance
account address parameter of balanceOf/_mint/_burn
Local uint256 currentAllowance read from _allowances in transferFrom and decreaseAllowance
Local uint256 senderBalance read from _balances[sender] in _transfer
Local uint256 accountBalance read from _balances[account] in _burn

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by Context._msgSender(), making the caller an untrusted data source for all entry points
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the sender argument of the internal transfer
approve uses _msgSender() as the owner of the allowance being granted
transferFrom uses _msgSender() to read and decrement the spender allowance
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the initial supply to _msgSender(), i.e. to the untrusted deployer
transfer calls the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom calls _transfer before adjusting the allowance
transferFrom calls _approve to store the reduced allowance
approve calls _approve with the caller as owner
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the computed new allowance
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the computed reduced allowance
SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply
_transfer invokes the overridable hook _beforeTokenTransfer before balances are updated, a classic reentrancy/hook ordering hazard
_mint invokes the overridable hook _beforeTokenTransfer before total supply and balances are updated
_burn invokes the overridable hook _beforeTokenTransfer before balances and total supply are updated
ServicePayer constructor performs an external payable call to an arbitrary receiver while the contract is still being constructed
name() returns the _name state variable
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable
totalSupply() returns the _totalSupply state variable
balanceOf reads _balances[account]
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender]
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender] to validate the spender allowance
_approve writes the new value into the _allowances mapping
generator() returns the constant _GENERATOR string
version() returns the _version state variable
GeneratorCopyright constructor assigns version_ into the _version state variable
_transfer reads _balances[sender] into senderBalance
_mint reads and increases the _totalSupply state variable
name_ is consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor
name_ is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor to initialise _name
symbol_ is consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor
symbol_ is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor to initialise _symbol
initialBalance_ is validated (> 0) inside the SimpleERC20 constructor
initialBalance_ becomes the amount argument of the _mint call
feeReceiver_ is a constructor argument of SimpleERC20
feeReceiver_ is forwarded as the receiver of the payable ServicePayer constructor
receiver is the payable recipient used by ServicePayer
receiver is the target address of the external IPayable.pay call
serviceName is a constructor argument of ServicePayer
serviceName is passed as calldata to the external IPayable.pay call
version_ is assigned to _version by the GeneratorCopyright constructor
recipient is the destination account of _transfer
amount is transferred by transfer
amount is the value moved and deducted from the allowance in transferFrom
amount is minted by _mint
amount is burned by _burn
amount is the allowance value set by approve
sender is the source account of _transfer
sender is the allowance owner checked by transferFrom
spender receives the allowance in approve
spender is the second key read by allowance
spender receives the increased allowance
spender has its allowance decreased
spender is the second argument of _approve
owner is the first key read by allowance
owner is the first argument of _approve
addedValue is added to the current allowance
subtractedValue is subtracted from the current allowance
account is the lookup key of balanceOf
account receives the minted tokens
account has tokens burned from its balance
transferFrom loads _allowances[sender][msg.sender] into currentAllowance
decreaseAllowance loads _allowances[msg.sender][spender] into currentAllowance
currentAllowance is the minuend of the allowance subtraction performed by transferFrom
the reduced currentAllowance value is written back through _approve
_transfer loads _balances[sender] into senderBalance
senderBalance is the minuend of the sender balance subtraction
_burn loads _balances[account] into accountBalance
accountBalance is checked against amount before the total supply subtraction
_transfer executes the sender balance subtraction
_transfer executes the recipient balance addition
_mint executes the total supply addition
_burn executes the total supply subtraction
transferFrom executes the allowance subtraction before storing the new allowance
decreaseAllowance executes the allowance subtraction after the require check
the computed difference is written back into _balances[sender]
the computed sum is written into _balances[recipient]
the incremented value is written back into _totalSupply by _mint
the decremented value is written back into _totalSupply by _burn
the reduced allowance is persisted into the _allowances mapping
the reduced allowance is persisted into the _allowances mapping by _approve

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a constructor parameter of SimpleERC20 and should be normalised into the SimpleERC20 constructor node
symbol_ is a constructor parameter of SimpleERC20 and should be normalised into the SimpleERC20 constructor node
initialBalance_ is validated inside the SimpleERC20 constructor, so it merges into that constructor node
feeReceiver_ is a constructor parameter of SimpleERC20 and merges into the SimpleERC20 constructor node
receiver is declared by the ServicePayer constructor and is directly related to it
serviceName is used as calldata of the external IPayable.pay call, so it merges into that unsafe operation
version_ is declared by the GeneratorCopyright constructor and merges into it
recipient is a parameter of the internal _transfer routine
amount is a parameter of the internal _transfer routine where the arithmetic occurs
sender is a parameter of the internal _transfer routine
spender is a parameter of the internal _approve routine used for allowance bookkeeping
owner is a parameter of the internal _approve routine used for allowance bookkeeping
addedValue is a parameter of increaseAllowance and merges into that function
subtractedValue is a parameter of decreaseAllowance and merges into that function
account is a parameter of the internal _mint routine that changes balances and total supply
currentAllowance is a local variable feeding the allowance subtraction unsafe operation
senderBalance is a local variable feeding the balance subtraction unsafe operation
accountBalance is a local variable feeding the total supply subtraction unsafe operation
